notes: A picture in a row of your Word price list is now kept as that product's photo, and the agent can send it when a customer asks to see the thing. A photo column with nothing typed under it used to shift every row's prices one column left; that is fixed. Counting the pieces in a pack is priced in packs: 20 gel pens of a pack of 10 is 2 packs. Delivery charged by place uses the city the customer named, or gives each charge and asks. An advance-payment rule is no longer read as a discount. And it no longer loses a count because the product's name has a number in it, or says it does not stock something it does sell.
